newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares climb despite fall on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: German shares climb despite fall on Wall Street.

text.p: 0704 GMT - German shares up slightly in pre-bourse IBIS computer trading despite a heafty slide on Wall Street. Traders see consolidation after what had been seven straight record-setting sessions, the DAX likely finding support above 4,000. Mark weak vs dollar, falls to two-year low vs yen.
* Dow Jones Industrials down 119.88 points at 7,842.43.
* Bundesbank news conference scheduled for 1015 GMT.
* Siemens most heavily traded share, up 96 pfennigs.
* Banks seen favoured after gains on Wednesday.
